scenario: Parent assistant launches one bg Bash (8s) AND one local_agent subagent (10s), both with run_in_background:true, then ends with stop_reason=end_turn. Tests whether the bg Bash short-circuits the result-envelope delay or whether the local_agent dominates.
conclusion: When ANY local_agent is in flight at parent end_turn, Claude CLI delays the `result` envelope until that local_agent completes — even if other backgrounded tasks (bg Bash) finish earlier. The bg Bash's task_notification triggers an interim re-round but does not produce a `result`. Backgrounded local_bash alone does not delay `result` (see ndjson_outlives.log).
purpose: Confirms the result-delay behavior is keyed on local_agent specifically, not on any backgrounded task.
